create_netstat_monitor: create a NetStat monitor instance with a custom interval and job UUID to track network stats
collect_network_counters: collect raw network counters like rx_bytes and tx_packets from all interfaces via collect_counters
calculate_network_rates: calculate per-second network rates between two data points using calculate_rates with a duration
run_netstat_collector: run the NetStat collector in a background thread to continuously gather network performance data
terminate_netstat_collector: terminate the running NetStat collector thread and wait for it to finish cleanly
